title: A · 清新低多边形
prompt:
Create a polished art-direction concept image for a 3D miniature-planet civilization management game, shown as an actual calm gameplay screen. Landscape 3:2 canvas. One complete small spherical planet is the hero, centered and occupying approximately 78 percent of the canvas height. Comfortable 3/4 orbital overview, nearly orthographic perspective, entire circular silhouette visible, generous clear margin. The user manages the whole planet; no controllable hero, no character portrait, no third-person camera.

Show a young civilization at the transition from agriculture to early industry: six small village houses, four organized crop fields, a compact mine nestled into one rocky hill, one modest smelting workshop, a central storage building, connected simple roads and two tiny transport carts. Two distinct forest patches, sculpted hills, a curved coastline and a calm blue body of water give the globe clear geography. Terrain and paths wrap convincingly around the sphere. Buildings and trees stand perpendicular to their LOCAL spherical ground, including along the curved sides. The front hemisphere contains attractive, well-spaced readable districts, with uncluttered stretches of landscape. Scale all facilities as miniatures on the sphere; the whole globe remains much more prominent than any individual structure. A few tiny anonymous working citizens may be visible only as ambient scale details.

Keep interface extremely minimal: a narrow translucent resource strip near the upper left, containing only three tiny resource pictograms and simple numbers; a small floating translucent dock of four icon-only management buttons centered close to the bottom edge. Crisp, tasteful interface with generous spacing. No large panels covering the planet, no labels over every building, no prominent typography, no title, no watermark, no logo, no dialogue, no diagram arrows. No spacecraft, no star battles, no second planet, no city megastructures. The image should feel like a compelling attainable indie game art target with readable building silhouettes and exquisite cohesive composition. Carefully separate visual layers through color and lighting.

ART DIRECTION FOR THIS VERSION:
Bright, fresh, sophisticated low-poly 3D art. Explicitly visible large triangular facets in the terrain, rocks and mountain surfaces; polygonal emerald and sage conifer trees; simple sharply legible ochre-roofed houses. Crisp flat-shaded geometry with gentle ambient occlusion, no photographic textures. Saturated turquoise water contrasts with warm grassy plateaus and cream stone. Palette of mint, jade, teal, warm terracotta and soft golden wheat. Light cool-blue to pale slate studio-like background suggesting serene space, almost empty. Broad soft sunlight from upper left, gentle shadows, no harsh black. Friendly, clean and strategically readable. Faceted geometry must be an obvious part of the design, sophisticated rather than blocky voxel art. Light frosted-glass UI with charcoal icons.

title: D · 深色极简科技
prompt:
Create an exceptionally minimal, geometric, premium 3D miniature-planet management game concept. The overriding art direction is a sleek architectural model made from immaculate smooth colored resin: large untextured surfaces, simple sculpted volumes, deliberately very few details. A radically simplified designed world, no photorealism, no grass texture, no pebbles, no timber texture, no shingled roofs, no individually rendered crop plants.

Landscape 3:2 canvas. One full spherical mini planet, centered, approximately 78 percent of image height, shown in a slightly elevated nearly orthographic orbital view with generous clean margin all around. Entire sphere silhouette is visible. Deep midnight-navy background, nearly empty. Planet consists of a perfectly smooth dark blue ocean and a few gently elevated smooth jade/teal land masses with elegant curved coastlines. One restrained warm key light and cool cyan rim light. Land and ocean form a complete round sphere, never a flat floating island or cutaway.

On the visible hemisphere, place a small early-industrial civilization with extremely readable simplified shapes. Six little ivory buildings are plain cream architectural blocks with single dark rectangular window cuts and clean wedge roofs, no roof tiles or rustic details. One smelting factory is a clean ivory rectangular volume with one short copper cylindrical chimney. Four farms are flat warm-gold inset rectangular patches with only five clean parallel lines each. Two forests each contain seven trees made from ONE smooth rounded capsule canopy on a short cylindrical trunk. One quarry is a very simple gray sculpted hill with a single dark arch and three ore cubes. A tiny cream storage pavilion sits at the center. Thin warm cream road ribbons connect everything, with two very tiny capsule-shaped carts. All buildings and trees align outward perpendicular to their local curved spherical surface. Leave large areas of smooth restful teal land between districts. Palette limited to midnight navy, dark ocean blue, jade, ivory and small amber accents. Focus on harmonious shapes, whitespace, organization and strong silhouettes. Stylish restrained game art, with the tactile quality of a high-end industrial design model.

The player manages the whole planet, so no hero, no character portrait, no third-person camera. Only two tiny UI elements: an ultra-thin smoked translucent upper-left resource strip with three small pictograms and simple numbers, and a restrained floating translucent lower-center dock with four fine white icon-only management controls and one subtle cyan selection accent. No big panels, no labels across the globe, no title, no logo, no watermark, no diagram arrows. No spacecraft or second planets. Keep the entire image deliberately minimalist, precise, smooth, beautiful and graphically legible. The visible world must read as simplified resin geometry rather than a natural landscape photograph.
